messages:
mika: seeing a spike in apiserver 5xx in eu-west1 starting ~10:20UTC, leader election count jumped.
raj: confirmed. etcd leader flipped 6x in 4m, controller-manager requeues spiking, GPU onboarding jobs stuck.
ina: network team rolled a NAT gateway change around 10:18, suspecting SNAT churn.
sre-oncall: throwing up a temporary ip route to bypass the new natgw for controlplane -> etcd endpoints.
ops-jen: redirecting heavy GPU provisioning to eu-central for now (jobs with label onboarding=true). will patch autoscaler to avoid cross-region bursts.
raj: etcdctl endpoint status shows one follower with high RTT:

```
# etcdctl --endpoints=https://10.0.8.12:2379 endpoint status
10.0.8.12:2379, 220ms, healthy, leader=3
10.0.7.9:2379, 18ms, healthy, leader=3
```

mika: that 220ms is the problem — controlplane heartbeats time out and leader flips + apiserver returns 503.
sre-oncall: rolling controller-manager with FLANNEL_MTU tweak and bumping --leader-elect-retry-period to reduce churn for 15m.
ina: applied sticky SNAT on the natgw (iptables --random-fully -> turned off for consistency) — testing.
raj: tailing apiserver logs now, still seeing short bursts but leader has stabilized after the snat change.

```
# kubectl -n kube-system logs deploy/kube-apiserver | grep "error|leader"
E0321 10:21:23.123 apiserver.go:xxx] failed to proxy: dial tcp 10.0.8.12:2379: i/o timeout
I0321 10:23:45.456 controller.go:yy] leader election: acquired
```

ops-jen: routed non-critical image pulls and model onboarding to eu-central to reduce pressure on eu-west GPU pool. note: cost increase ~+12% for the hour.
sam: recommend we temporarily disable cross-zone burst on Dedicated GPU autoscaler to prevent more attach storms. I'll queue a config change.

```
# curl -X PATCH https://infra-api/auto-scaler/modify -d '{"cross_zone_burst":false}'
```

deploy-bot: canary rollback of natgw config executed by @nina at 10:34UTC :white_check_mark:

mika: monitoring for 30m, create postmortem if it reoccurs. opened INC-1234 and assigned to eng-sre/networking.
sre-oncall: FYI - please add any perf graphs to the ticket (apiserver latency, etcd leader changes, natgw errors). set next steps: keep sticky SNAT until we validate NAT churn fixes in staging.
raj: adding a note to scheduler: defer GPU onboarding jobs for 10m backoff to avoid thundering attach once network stabilizes.
